paper.title: JoinBoost: Grow Trees Over Normalized Data Using Only SQL

risks: The inspected repository contains only 21 Python files, and no explicit end-to-end test or benchmark command was extracted, so benchmark packaging will require additional engineering.
The probe reports a GPU requirement, which could complicate reproducible evaluation unless the benchmark isolates a CPU-only JoinBoost path or standardizes accelerator access.
Full-scale TPC-DS SF=1000 experiments are too expensive for routine agent evaluation; strict scale and timeout limits are necessary.
Cross-DBMS performance can be noisy and environment-sensitive, requiring pinned engine versions, fixed resources, warm-up rules, and repeated measurements.
Citation and repository-star evidence supplied here is zero, so broad impact and adoption are not yet demonstrated.
